title: Morning mantra: one face, one line, one goal for the day
summary: Lip-sync one line of a trending song as you start your day, with your own funny "morning mantra" on screen. AI writes the mantras.
why: NapoleonCat's Instagram Reels trends page, published November 1, 2026, lists a quieter "morning mantra" version of a trending pop-song Reel: one face, one lip-synced line and one text overlay, for anyone who would rather not dance. It's a new, low-effort twist on the same mid-October song behind our "POV: busy until 5" pack.
steps: Think about how your day really starts and the one small goal you're chasing.
Use the main prompt to get short "morning mantra" lines.
Film yourself walking into your day, like out the door, into the kitchen or behind the counter, and lip-sync one line of the trending sound.
Put one mantra on screen and post. Add the sound from the app's own library.

prompts.label: Main prompt
prompts.text: Write 10 short on-screen lines that start with "Morning mantra:" for a lip-sync video. Each one is a tiny, honest, slightly funny goal for my day, under 10 words. Example: "Morning mantra: reply to that email before lunch." About my day: [your job, school or home life, and the small things you're always trying to get done]. Keep them upbeat and kind. No hashtags, no emojis.

prompts.label: Variation: week of mantras
prompts.text: Plan a week of "Morning mantra:" videos, Monday to Sunday. For each day, give one on-screen mantra under 10 words and one simple setting to film in, using only places I already have: [your home, commute, work or school spots]. Make the mantras build a small story across the week, like getting ready for [an event or goal you have coming up].

prompts.label: Variation: family or pets
prompts.text: Write 8 "Morning mantra:" lines from the point of view of my [pet, or a family member who has agreed to be filmed]. They describe their morning goals in a funny, sweet way, for example a dog whose mantra is "Morning mantra: be near the toaster." About them: [what they're like in the morning]. Under 10 words each.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run [type of business] in [town]. Write 8 "Morning mantra:" lines I can lip-sync as I open up for the day. Use real parts of our morning, like [one or two examples: unlocking the door, the first batch, loading the van]. Under 10 words each. Then write one short caption with our real opening hours. Don't make up sales, numbers or customer quotes.

tips: Film where your day really starts: the front door, the van, the front desk. A plain, real spot reads better than a polished studio.
One line on screen is enough. Leave it up for the whole clip.
Not a dancer? You don't need to be. Just walk in and mouth one line.
Pick the sound from the app's library. Business accounts should use the commercial sound library.
